calculation.paybackPeriodTooltip: How long it takes for the money you save on fuel and electricity to cover the cost of installing the solar panels.
calculation.solarYieldTooltip: How much electricity the solar panels are expected to generate.
calculation.co2SavedTooltip: How much pollution is avoided by using solar power instead of the grid or fuel.
calculation.netSavingsTooltip: The overall money saved, after accounting for the cost of the panels.
calculation.requestedByTooltip: Who asked for this calculation to be run.
calculation.calculatedOnTooltip: The exact date and time these results were produced.
calculation.formulaVersionTooltip: Which version of our calculation method produced this result, in case the method improves over time.
calculation.assumptionSetTooltip: The bundle of default assumptions (typical costs, panel wear over time, etc.) used in this calculation.
calculation.inputSnapshotCapturedTooltip: The vehicle details used at the time, frozen in place, so later edits to the vehicle won't change this report.
calculation.energyPriceAssumptionsTooltip: The electricity and fuel prices assumed for this calculation.
calculation.emissionsFactorAssumptionsTooltip: The pollution-per-kWh figures used to estimate CO2 saved.
calculation.solarYieldAssumptionsTooltip: The solar panel performance data used to estimate power generated.
calculation.currencyConversionSourceTooltip: Where the exchange rate came from, if the numbers needed converting to a different currency.
